fok_order_placed.meaning: A user has placed a Fill-or-Kill order on the CLOB contract intended to be filled in full

only_dust_remainder.meaning: The only unfilled remainder of the FOK order is the dust amount rounded off by lot size

order_otherwise_fillable.meaning: Aside from the dust remainder the FOK order is a valid, fillable trade

order_reverts.meaning: The legitimate FOK order reverts instead of completing

assumptions: The unfilled remainder that triggers the revert is attributable to lot-size rounding rather than insufficient market-side liquidity (as_dust_from_rounding).
Market-side liquidity apart from the dust remainder is sufficient for the order to be otherwise fillable.
Placing and executing a FOK order requires no authorization beyond the placing user.

unresolved.description: The exact dust threshold or lot-size rounding rule separating acceptable dust from a meaningful unfilled amount is not defined.
The specific contract function or checkpoint where the revert fires is not identified.
It is not independently verified that liquidity was sufficient to fill the order aside from the dust remainder.

limitations: Only the core impact v_order_reverts is formalized; the secondary availability impact v_availability_loss is deferred.
The dust threshold and lot-size rounding rule are undefined, so the condition is modeled as a Boolean.
The precise revert checkpoint/function is not identified.
Sufficiency of market liquidity apart from dust is asserted, not verified.
